name: Staré Hradiště (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a blue upper hoist part and a black lower fly part, with a white wavy diagonal band bearing a blue wavy stripe along the division.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 4 June 1998 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
